FM1_baseline_ceiling.BASELINE_CEILING_PLAUSIBLE: ROI median O0 in top-2 of 7 ROIs AND ROI median G <= 0.02 AND normalization improves the ROI's rank (rank by normalized_G at least 2 positions better than rank by raw G)
FM1_baseline_ceiling.BASELINE_CEILING_NOT_PRIMARY: ROI median O0 not in top-2 OR ROI median G > 0.02

FM4_beta_dependence.unit: participant (N=8); Delta_G_beta = G_B0 - G_B1; Delta_R = R_B0 - R_B1 (median over 7 ROIs per participant)
FM4_beta_dependence.BETA_OPERATOR_DEPENDENCE_NOT_EXPLAINED_B: Spearman < 0.2 for both imagery and vision

FM5_stability.compare: FULL_CROSS_VOXEL vs NO_EVIDENCE cells on mean_pairwise_action_cosine; and G vs action_cosine Spearman per ROI
FM5_stability.INSTABILITY_DOMINANT: std_median_diff(action_cosine, FULL-vs-NO) >= 1.0 AND median per-ROI Spearman(G, action_cosine) >= 0.5

FM2_FM3_measurement.metric: per-ROI Spearman(reliability, G) across 8 participants; and per-participant across 7 ROIs

FM8_stimulus.SUPPORTED_PATTERN: failure concentrated (top-2 identities contribute > 40% of excess residual)
